summary: IRRBB and Asset Liability Management specialist with ~7 years across interest rate risk measurement, balance sheet analytics, and model governance. At Moody's Analytics, holds delegated sign-off on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios ($5–25bn per engagement); led a multi-scenario cash flow projection engine and IRRBB-analogous analytics under parallel and non-parallel shocks, covering both economic-value (EVE) and earnings dimensions, applied in frameworks consistent with OSFI B-12 / BCBS 368. CFA charterholder with dual MSc; advisory background spans Treasury-facing institutional clients across banks, pension funds, and insurers.
core_skills: Behavioral Cash Flow Modelling (Prepayment, Prepayment Logic)
Cash Flow Projection & Liquidity Gap Analytics

sections.heading: IRRBB & Balance Sheet Risk Measurement
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs delivered to multi-asset institutional client portfolios ranging $5–25bn per engagement — independently review curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release.

Review interest rate risk and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks, in frameworks consistent with OSFI B-12 and BCBS 368 — outputs cover economic-value (EVE) and earnings-based sensitivity dimensions analogous to bank Treasury IRRBB measurement.

Validate derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation — verify consistency of sensitivities and scenario impacts at portfolio-level ALM aggregates feeding downstream balance sheet risk and capital processes.

sections.heading: Cash Flow Projection, Behavioral Assumptions & ETL Pipelines
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios — delivering forward-looking liquidity and earnings visibility across ALM horizons relevant to balance sheet and funding management.
Architected configurable time-bucketed gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year) enabling funding optimization, refinancing risk assessment, and balance sheet management decisions.
Embedded behavioral cash flow assumptions and prepayment logic, with macro stress overlays — covering the non-trading balance sheet behavioral mechanics relevant to IRRBB measurement.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable, auditable Python and SQL extract/transform/load pipelines with embedded balance-and-control checks, logging, and version control.

sections.heading: ALCO Reporting, Attribution & Model Documentation
bullets: Prepare analytical summaries for senior stakeholders — including clients' Heads of Risk and investment committees — covering interest rate exposure, scenario impacts, attribution of risk-measurement changes, and balance sheet sensitivities consistent with ALCO reporting standards.
Maintain documentation of risk-measurement methodology, model assumptions, and procedures within a formal model governance framework; escalate outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe analytics platform — advised on asset, liability, and ALM configurations and validated model outputs post-deployment.
Scoped client investment-team requirements into structured Product Owner requests; contributed to successful migration of all assigned client accounts from legacy Calypso to PFaroe PM.

roles.title: Senior Consultant — IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 technology-transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients — aligned regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.
Advised actuarial, finance, IT, and PM functions on standard adoption; contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes.
Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds — analyzed funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance sheet risk under base-case and stressed environments.

Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators measuring interest rate risk and funding volatility; performed cash flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across rates, inflation, and currency.
Conducted liability-driven investment (LDI) analysis on duration alignment and liquidity trade-offs; presented findings to investment committees on-site.
Modelled pension actuarial liabilities alongside major investment products and economic variables; performed VaR/CVaR portfolio optimization and risk decomposition on Ortec's GLASS platform.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) — Western University, 2016
